extracted.name: Rice cake cress faces
extracted.description: Let your little ones create their own smiley faces using storecupboard rice cakes, veg and hummus or nut butter – it makes a quick and entertaining lunch
instruction_lines: Spread the hummus or nut butter over the rice cakes or corn cakes. Use the veg to create faces, snipping off some cress and using it to give the faces any desired hairstyle, beard or moustache.
